title: Functional gel materials for next-generation electrochromic devices and applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3475-3512
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01256A, Review Article
Yuyang Wang, Xiaoyan Sun, Quanbing Liu, Guihua Yu
This review underscores the essential role of gel materials in electrochromic technology, offering a comprehensive analysis of gelation chemistry and valuable insights into the practical deployment of gel-based electrochromic devices.
